name: Kennyo
source:
Hobby: Feeding Animals
Special Skill: Dodgy Dealings
Charm Point: Appearing and disappearing randomly in the forest

A monk who holds a deep resentment for Nobunaga. There is no end to the lengths he would go to exact his revenge. Though he knows it's a futile act, he always clasps his hands in prayer after offing an opponent.

"Tell me, miss. How shall I make you cry?"

[from the app]
